import json, numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def transform(grid):
    arr=np.array(grid)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(arr>0,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    figs=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        m=lab==i; ys,xs=np.nonzero(m)
        figs.append(arr[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1])
    a,b=figs
    rows=[]
    for r in range(a.shape[0]):
        if not np.array_equal(a[r],b[r]):
            rows.append([8 if a[r,c]!=b[r,c] else 0 for c in range(a.shape[1])])
    return rows

    exp=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i, pred==exp)
    ok &= pred==exp
print('ALL OK', ok)
if ok:
    test_out=transform(G['Test input'])
